residue_integer_crt — RESIDUE theorem op

• 資料種類:signal × signal → table

• 呼叫: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.residue_integer_crt(residues, moduli) -> 'dict'(要直接呼叫實作,import residue; residue.residue_integer_crt(residues, moduli) -> 'dict';從台帳取用則 opsresidue.get("residue_integer_crt"))

用法

精確的整數中國剩餘定理（Garner 混合基數演算法）-> dict。

> 以下的詳細說明為原文 —— 摘要與標題已翻譯。

residues and moduli are equal-length integer sequences; the moduli must be pairwise coprime and >= 2. Returns {"value": int, "modulus": int, "mixed_radix": [digits]} where value is the unique solution in [0, prod(moduli)). Arithmetic is Python's arbitrary-precision int — there is no rounding anywhere, which is why this op is the oracle for residue_crt.

The mixed-radix digits d_k satisfy value = d_0 + d_1 m_0 + d_2 m_0 m_1 + ...:

the *positional* (coarse-to-fine) reading of the same residues, i.e. the bridge between the residue view and the place-value view.
